datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Chad in 2015, classifying geographic areas by food insecurity severity phase. The data represents medium-term projections of acute food insecurity conditions aggregated at administrative unit level with temporal snapshots in January, April, July, and October 2015.
